families.name: SOURCE_COORDINATES
families.coverage: LF, CRLF, mixed endings, lone CR, no-final-newline EOF insertions, supplementary characters, combining marks, wide glyphs and tabs through SourceText.

families.name: QUERY_DIAGNOSTICS
families.coverage: Unknown-token diagnostics across LF, CRLF, lone CR, supplementary and combining comment text, wide glyphs and tabs before the original query error.

families.name: DIAGNOSTIC_DISPLAY
families.coverage: Raw context snippets, LSP JSON ranges, tab expansion, supplementary and wide display cells, combining marks, and escaped NUL/backspace/form-feed presentation.

families.name: SCHEMA_DIAGNOSTICS
families.coverage: Binary-schema invalid-endianness positions across LF, CRLF, tabs, Unicode comments/names, supplementary characters and no-final-newline input.

contract.observation: The immutable initial coordinate/display matrix remained unchanged after observation; no oracle correction was required.

initialCandidateReplay.finding: DiagnosticFormatter emitted raw tabs and control characters and positioned carets with UTF-16 source columns instead of terminal display cells. D03 (supplementary emoji) passed because its source and terminal widths coincided at the tested boundary.

focusedReplay.coverage: The permanent matrix executes all 48 registered cases plus its 48-case uniqueness control across SourceText, ParseResult, schema diagnostics and display/JSON surfaces.

productionFindings.description: Terminal diagnostic formatting conflated UTF-16 source columns with terminal display cells and passed raw control characters through snippets.
productionFindings.repair: Preserve raw structured snippets; extract their source lines, expand tabs to four-column stops, escape remaining controls, account for combining marks and wide Unicode scalars, and compute caret start/length in display cells.

obligations.REC-121-O01: All twelve SourceText and query/schema cases cover LF, CRLF, mixed/lone-CR layouts, no-final-newline input and zero-length EOF insertion behavior; every observed span resolves against the original source text.
obligations.REC-121-O02: Supplementary characters, decomposed combining marks, wide glyphs and tabs occur before observed regions in source, query diagnostics, schema diagnostics and display cases.
obligations.REC-121-O03: SourceText, Diagnostic, ParseResult, schema envelope and formatter JSON assertions record UTF-16 offsets/columns; terminal assertions separately record display-cell columns and LSP JSON records zero-based line/character values.
obligations.REC-121-O04: Raw ContextSnippet assertions retain original controls, while formatted output is independently required to be control-safe and caret-aligned; JSON is parsed as a separate machine surface.
obligations.acceptance: Every final coordinate resolves to the intended original input region; terminal formatting no longer uses display width as a source coordinate.

notes: The initial replay exposed one production formatter finding across eleven display cases; the frozen case contract and pre-observation manifest were not changed.
The final focused matrix passed 49/49 and the complete parser test project passed 2,667/2,667.

The authoritative full Release gate passed all 8/8 expected targets with only the three established generated-refresh skips. Product and empirical lanes remain outside the engine-lane stopping contract.
